answer: One concrete mechanism: mix in randomly chosen human-authored live tasks that cannot be precomputed, because pulse only stays cheap while clones that dodge the live lane lose the epoch payout entirely. Concretely, terrace is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any atlas approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
